audit.why: Early is Irelia's (Q resets, level 1 all-in), mid is skill, side/teamfight tilts Viktor at 2+ items. Matches 51.63% WR over 4724 games.
Spikes: levels 3-5 waveclear, level 6 even (her R catch vs his channel), first item shove/roam, two items dominant. Content spikes[] already carries this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Viktor's E called 'Death Ray' in spikes[0].text, whys[1] and content mid — kit says Hextech Ray. Full layer misgenders Irelia in 19 fields. breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: E text is 'fire a Hextech Ray'. Irelia is she/her per champ-gender. Real CDs: her E 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Q 10-6 with reset, W 20-12, R 125/105/85; Viktor W 17-13.
audit.corrected: See edits: Hextech Ray substituted, pronouns fixed, cooldown numbers added.

audit.why: Flawless Duet 16s rank 1 is the punish window; Viktor W 17s is the lifeline.

edits.before: Push the wave and use E (Death Ray) to clear her minions so she can't Q (Bladesurge) reset through them onto you. Hold W (Gravity Field) as your anti-engage: drop it the instant she dashes in and the stun zone punishes her stun combo.
edits.after: Push the wave and use E (Hextech Ray) to clear her minions so she can't Q (Bladesurge) reset through them onto you. Hold W (Gravity Field) as your anti-engage: drop it the instant she dashes in — the field slows and stuns her mid-combo.

edits.before: By L2 your Death Ray and improving trades even out her reset threat.
edits.after: By L2 your Hextech Ray and improving trades even out her reset threat.

edits.before: From lvl 2 onward it's a skill matchup. Death Ray clears her reset fodder and W deters her dashes, so if you manage the wave and hold W for her engage you neutralize her all-in windows through the mid-game.
edits.after: From lvl 2 onward it's a skill matchup. Hextech Ray clears her reset fodder and W deters her dashes, so if you manage the wave and hold W for her engage you neutralize her all-in windows through the mid-game.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (E) is 16s at rank 1 — her only stun setup; step forward the moment both blades fire. - Bladesurge is 10s down to 6s but resets on marked or dying targets, so deny low minions. - Your W is 17s: the lifeline, never a poke tool.
